p2.effect: Buffered close or normal interpreter finalization attempts the pending payload again outside the intended active deadline check. The run remains failed; no extra publication attempt is permitted.

p2.minimal_fix: Use caller-owned unbuffered source writes and a bounded raw/nonblocking summary with no pending Python buffer at teardown. Preserve exclusive0600, caps, explicit fsync, partial/unknown states, exact launchers, unchanged common/time and COPY regular reservations. No extra time or retry.
p2.proof: Static exception/cleanup flow plus official pinned CPython source; no runtime or fault injection.
